summary.description: One or two sentences: overall verdict and the most important finding.

verdict.description: pass: no defects; pass_with_notes: only low severity; fail: at least one high or medium defect; blocked: the task could not be completed.

file.description: Workspace-relative path, or empty when not file specific.

line.description: 1-indexed line the finding anchors to; 0 when unknown.

category.description: Short kebab-case slug such as correctness, security, efficiency, test-coverage, simplification.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input or state that leads to the wrong output or crash.

confidence.description: confirmed when verified against the code, plausible otherwise.

verification.description: Commands run or evidence read to support the verdict.
